items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was named after her – Karee – that’s K-a-r-double-e. Grandberry was her maiden name.

ctx.x: Next thing you know. So what were . . . ? Let me get some of these people’s names – complete names – on record. I guess we start with your parents’ names.

My father’s name was George Thomas Freeman, Sr. My mother’s name was Earle – E-a-r-l-e – but I was named after her – Karee – that’s K-a-r-double-e. Grandberry was her maiden name. Of course she married my father, Freeman. Bruz’s name is Eldridge Edmond Freeman.
